title: overlook — overwhelming

translations.translation: 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上

sentences.sentence: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
sentences.translation: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

sentences.sentence: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
sentences.translation: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

sentences.sentence: Employers may become overly cautious about taking on new staff.
sentences.translation: 雇主在雇用新员工的问题上可能会过于谨慎。

sentences.sentence: He became a millionaire overnight.
sentences.translation: 他一夜之间就成了百万富翁。

phrases.translation: 手动超越控制；并联手动阀

sentences.sentence: The president vetoed the bill, and the Senate failed by a single vote to override his veto.
sentences.translation: 总统否决了议案，而参议院因一票之差未能推翻他的否决。

sentences.sentence: The House of Lords overruled the decision of the Court of Appeal.
sentences.translation: 上议院推翻了上诉法院的判决。

sentences.sentence: They have the power to overrule the local council.
sentences.translation: 他们有权否决地方议会的决定。

sentences.translation: 认为季节性的海外海鲜的价格是合理的就是背叛。

sentences.sentence: It's a treason that terror of the seasonal oversea seafood is reasonable.
sentences.translation: 认为季节性的海外海鲜的价格是合理的就是背叛。

sentences.sentence: Joshua Russell: Some oversea workers have done so well, they've been able to outsouce their own outsourced works to those even poorer than themselves.
sentences.translation: 一些海外"接包"人员进展得相当好，他们已经能够将接到的外包工作再外包给那些甚至比他们自己还穷困的人。

phrases.translation: 国外分支机构；海外分店

sentences.sentence: Chris is going to work overseas.
sentences.translation: 克里斯要去国外工作。

sentences.sentence: Most applications came from overseas.
sentences.translation: 大部分申请来自海外。

translations.translation: 使失色；使阴暗；遮阴；夺去…的光彩

sentences.sentence: Hester is overshadowed by her younger and more attractive sister.
sentences.translation: 她那更年轻而且更有魅力的妹妹使赫斯特黯然失色。

sentences.sentence: I assure you that this was purely an oversight on my part.
sentences.translation: 我向你保证，这纯粹是我的一时疏忽。

sentences.sentence: To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
sentences.translation: 说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。

sentences.sentence: The importance of a child’s early years cannot be overstated (= is very important ).
sentences.translation: 儿童幼年期的重要性怎么强调也不为过。

sentences.sentence: Although there is no overt hostility, black and white students do not mix much.
sentences.translation: 虽然没有明显的敌意，但黑人学生和白人学生还是交往不多。

sentences.sentence: He pulled out to overtake the van.
sentences.translation: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

sentences.sentence: They were charged with plotting the overthrow of the state.
sentences.translation: 他们被控密谋颠覆国家。

sentences.translation: 六小时的加班

sentences.sentence: They’re working overtime to get the job finished.
sentences.translation: 他们正在加班赶工。

sentences.sentence: He’s been doing a lot of overtime recently.
sentences.translation: 他近来加班很多。

sentences.sentence: Many employees work countless hours of unpaid overtime.
sentences.translation: 许多员工无偿加班无数个小时。

sentences.sentence: Many of our offices will be working on overtime until the end of the year.
sentences.translation: 我们的许多办事处都要加班到年底。

sentences.translation: 莱斯莉一跃而起，碰倒了椅子。

sentences.translation: 他的汽车发生侧翻，把他困在了里面。

sentences.translation: 本书的中心部分是对药物使用的一个历史概述。

sentences.translation: 他略微超重。

sentences.translation: 有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。

sentences.sentence: An overwhelming majority of the members were against the idea.
sentences.translation: 占压倒性多数的成员反对这项主张。

sentences.sentence: The proposal has been given overwhelming support.
sentences.translation: 这一提议得到了压倒性多数的支持。

sentences.sentence: The British Air Force succeeded despite overwhelming odds against them.
sentences.translation: 英国空军虽然处境极为不利，但还是完成了任务。

sentences.sentence: The people voted overwhelmingly for change.
sentences.translation: 人们以绝对多数投票赞成变革。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 423 单元

overlook
音标：英 /əʊvə'lʊk/  美 /,ovɚ'lʊk/
v. 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上
n. 忽视；眺望
例句：It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
那样的小细节很容易被忽略。
例句：Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

overly
音标：英 /'əʊvəlɪ/  美 /'ovɚli/
adv. 过度地；极度地
n. (Overly)人名；(英)奥弗利
例句：Employers may become overly cautious about taking on new staff.
雇主在雇用新员工的问题上可能会过于谨慎。

overnight
音标：英 /əʊvə'naɪt/  美 /'ovənaɪt/
adv. 通宵；突然；昨晚
adj. 晚上的；通宵的；前夜的
n. 头天晚上；一夜的逗留
vt. 连夜快递
vi. 过一夜
例句：He became a millionaire overnight.
他一夜之间就成了百万富翁。

override
音标：英 /əʊvə'raɪd/  美 /,ovɚ'raɪd/
v. 推翻；不顾；践踏
n. 代理佣金
短语：manual override — 手动超越控制；并联手动阀
例句：The president vetoed the bill, and the Senate failed by a single vote to override his veto.
总统否决了议案，而参议院因一票之差未能推翻他的否决。

overrule
音标：英 /əʊvə'ruːl/  美 /,ovɚ'rul/
v. 否决；统治；对…施加影响
例句：The House of Lords overruled the decision of the Court of Appeal.
上议院推翻了上诉法院的判决。
例句：They have the power to overrule the local council.
他们有权否决地方议会的决定。

oversea
音标：英 /'əʊvə'siː/  美 /'ovɚ'si/
adj. 外国的；在海外的
adv. 国外；向国外，向海外
短语：oversea chinese — 海外华人
例句：It’s a treason terror of the seasonal oversea seafood is reasonable.
认为季节性的海外海鲜的价格是合理的就是背叛。
例句：It's a treason that terror of the seasonal oversea seafood is reasonable.
认为季节性的海外海鲜的价格是合理的就是背叛。
例句：Joshua Russell: Some oversea workers have done so well, they've been able to outsouce their own outsourced works to those even poorer than themselves.
一些海外"接包"人员进展得相当好，他们已经能够将接到的外包工作再外包给那些甚至比他们自己还穷困的人。

overseas
音标：英 /əʊvə'siːz/  美 /,ovɚ'siz/
adv. 在海外，海外
adj. 海外的，国外的
短语：overseas chinese — 华侨，海外华人
短语：overseas market — 海外市场
短语：overseas investment — 海外投资
短语：overseas trade — 海外贸易；对外贸易
短语：overseas student — 留学生
短语：overseas travel — 国外旅游，海外旅行
短语：returned overseas chinese — 归侨
短语：overseas department — 海外部
短语：overseas branch — 国外分支机构；海外分店
短语：overseas assets — 海外资产
短语：overseas bank — 国外银行
短语：overseas call — 国际电话
短语：overseas chinese affairs office — 侨务办公室
例句：Chris is going to work overseas.
克里斯要去国外工作。
例句：Most applications came from overseas.
大部分申请来自海外。

overshadow
音标：英 /əʊvə'ʃædəʊ/  美 /'ovɚ'ʃædo/
v. 使失色；使阴暗；遮阴；夺去…的光彩
例句：Hester is overshadowed by her younger and more attractive sister.
她那更年轻而且更有魅力的妹妹使赫斯特黯然失色。

oversight
音标：英 /'əʊvəsaɪt/  美 /'ovɚsaɪt/
n. 监督，照管；疏忽
例句：I assure you that this was purely an oversight on my part.
我向你保证，这纯粹是我的一时疏忽。

overstate
音标：英 /əʊvə'steɪt/  美 /,ovɚ'stet/
v. 夸张；夸大的叙述
例句：To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。
例句：The importance of a child’s early years cannot be overstated (= is very important ).
儿童幼年期的重要性怎么强调也不为过。

overt
音标：英 /əʊ'vɜːt; 'əʊvət/  美 /o'vɝt/
adj. 明显的；公然的；蓄意的
例句：Although there is no overt hostility, black and white students do not mix much.
虽然没有明显的敌意，但黑人学生和白人学生还是交往不多。

overtake
音标：英 /əʊvə'teɪk/  美 /,ovɚ'tek/
v. 赶上；压倒；突然来袭
例句：He pulled out to overtake the van.
他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

overthrow
音标：英 /əʊvə'θrəʊ/  美 /,ovɚ'θro/
n. 推翻；倾覆；瓦解
v. 推翻；打倒；倾覆
例句：They were charged with plotting the overthrow of the state.
他们被控密谋颠覆国家。

overtime
音标：英 /'əʊvətaɪm/  美 /,ovə'taɪm/
n. [劳经] 加班时间；延长时间；加时赛
adj. 超时的；加班的
vt. 使超过时间
adv. 加班地
短语：work overtime — 加班
短语：overtime pay — 加班费
短语：overtime work — 加班加点工作，超时工作
短语：overtime working — 加班工作
短语：overtime payment — 加班工资
例句：six hours’ overtime
六小时的加班
例句：They’re working overtime to get the job finished.
他们正在加班赶工。
例句：He’s been doing a lot of overtime recently.
他近来加班很多。
例句：Many employees work countless hours of unpaid overtime.
许多员工无偿加班无数个小时。
例句：Many of our offices will be working on overtime until the end of the year.
我们的许多办事处都要加班到年底。

overture
音标：英 /'əʊvətj(ʊ)ə/  美 /'ovətʃʊr/
n. 前奏曲；提案；序幕
vt. 提议；为……奏前奏曲

overturn
音标：英 /əʊvə'tɜːn/  美 /'ovətɝn/
v. 推翻；倾覆；破坏
n. 倾覆；周转；破灭
例句：Leslie jumped to her feet, overturning her chair.
莱斯莉一跃而起，碰倒了椅子。
例句：His car overturned, trapping him inside.
他的汽车发生侧翻，把他困在了里面。

overview
音标：英 /'əʊvəvjuː/  美 /'ovɚ'vjʊ/
n. [图情] 综述；概观
短语：market overview — 市场概述
例句：The central section of the book is a historical overview of drug use.
本书的中心部分是对药物使用的一个历史概述。

overweight
音标：英 /əʊvə'weɪt/  美 /'ovə'wet/
adj. 超重的；过重的
vt. 使负担过重
n. 超重
例句：He is slightly overweight.
他略微超重。

overwhelm
音标：英 /əʊvə'welm/  美 /,ovɚ'wɛlm/
v. 淹没；压倒；受打击；覆盖；压垮

overwhelming
音标：美 /,ovɚ'wɛlmɪŋ/
adj. 压倒性的；势不可挡的
v. 压倒；淹没（overwhelm的ing形式）；制服
短语：overwhelming superiority — 绝对优势
例句：There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages your health.
有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。
例句：An overwhelming majority of the members were against the idea.
占压倒性多数的成员反对这项主张。
例句：The proposal has been given overwhelming support.
这一提议得到了压倒性多数的支持。
例句：The British Air Force succeeded despite overwhelming odds against them.
英国空军虽然处境极为不利，但还是完成了任务。
例句：The people voted overwhelmingly for change.
人们以绝对多数投票赞成变革。
